source.format: Public readable JavaScript ES modules, identical to the code shipped in the kit; no private repository access required. Compare file SHA-256 values in source-manifest.json.

execution.coordinators: The hooddice.workers.dev hosts are offchain Cloudflare services for sessions, realtime views, coordination and transaction delivery. The historical hostname does not establish where a game rule executes.
execution.games: For Cee-lo, slots, blackjack, fights and RPS, the kit checks receipts from the identified Solana programs, proof inputs, deterministic outcomes and the scoped transfers. Offchain service availability remains a dependency.
execution.poker: Client-verified encrypted shuffle; onchain commitments, betting, card openings and pot settlement. This kit lacks the complete historical shuffle/unlock transcript and wallet cash-out.
execution.perps: Solana-program financial execution on MagicBlock’s Solana-native SVM Ephemeral Rollups, with Solana base-layer custody and settlement. ER execution is not identical to L1 consensus. This VRF-game kit does not yet verify Perps price inputs, economics or USDC settlement.

references.label: MagicBlock: delegation, execution, commitment and undelegation

requirements: Node 22+, inspect the downloaded code first. No npm install, wallet, login or wager. Unzip with all files together.

exitCodes.0: All selected checks passed within their stated scope
exitCodes.1: Invalid, missing or unavailable evidence; not verified
exitCodes.2: Partial coverage or untested product; never a full-platform pass

trust: Archived mode checks supplied evidence, not fresh chain inclusion. --live fetches finalized receipts/accounts directly from the selected Solana RPC; it never silently falls back. Each example is one historical case, not aggregate payouts or newly played gameplay.

otherProducts.reason: Oracle-priced leveraged markets, not a VRF game. Requires entry/close price, haircut, liquidation, venue accounting and paid USDC settlement replay. A queued claim is not a payout.

payoutSummary.description: Sums successful distinct example gross payments by mint and destination. Table escrow is separate from player wallets; partial poker chips and untested Perps are excluded.
